rights.statement: NTRS: Public distribution; Use by or on behalf of the US Gov. Permitted.
rights.notes: Only factual transcription and a short observation are bundled. This is not a blanket public-domain assertion. PDF, figures, photos and video are not redistributed; separate permissions review required.

verification.notes: Downloaded original PDF, checked SHA-256 against upstream manifest, extracted and visually inspected Table A.1 PDF page 112 / printed 104. Calibrated oxygen columns are 17.4, not the adjacent 16.5 initial/final readings.

experiments.title: B20 — opposed-flow PMMA film

gravity.reason: ISS microgravity context is described by the report; acceleration for this run was not extracted.

flowDirection.note: Sample distance column in Table A.1.

oxygenPct.note: Calibrated initial O2 vol% column; final calibrated value also 17.4. Adjacent uncalibrated initial/final readings are 16.5.

pressureKpa.reason: No per-test pressure in Table A.1; do not substitute a series range.

flowCmS.note: First Air display entry only; later 3 and pot 0.5 retained in rawFlow.

thicknessMm.note: Material column states 100 micrometres; divided by 1000 to obtain mm.

claims.text: The B20 observation log reports that the flame burned the entire sample.
limitations: This record cannot establish lunar fire safety or isolate airflow causation.
